function: Excluded: Q-learning only decides the task offloading mode (local, edge or cloud); transmit power and CPU frequency come from an interior point method (pp. 6-7).
notes: above_phy. p. 7: "The task offloading decision is determined using a Q-learning algorithm" and "the agent takes action A as task offloading decision"; the only learned action is the processing mode per device. Transmit power and CPU frequency are solved by classical optimization, p. 6: "Using the interior point method (IPM) [25], [26] to assist solution", so no physical-layer decision is learned and the joint-decision clause does not apply. The title on page 1 matches the DOI.
